email.subject: Pearl Group Dentistry: no reviews showing
email.body:
Marcus,

Quick note on Pearl Group Dentistry's site. Two things stood out:

No patient reviews are displayed anywhere. In Harbor Falls, that's often the deciding factor when someone's comparing dentists before calling — no proof, no trust, and they call the next practice instead.

The footer also still shows outdated info, which makes the site feel unmaintained to a new visitor checking you're legit.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd fix and why. No pitch, just the rundown.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
Northlight Web
